scope: Original English basic-board standard semi-cooperative Nemesis, six original characters. English original manual including illustrated card text and scoped currentFAQ govern; PL/FR/DE original manuals supplement compatible details and expose differences without automatic precedence.
conclusion: PASS for included-claim source fidelity. Frozen full-iteration-12 summary matches the exact SHA256 of finalized source-passed candidate16, and all ten scoped source files are unchanged. Zero text or source differences require additional substantive assessment. Candidate16 exact-current-text/primary-source/illustration checks and retained pure-source checks carry forward transparently. This is not a fresh complete original-card-corpus review.

exact_byte_correspondence.method: Verified the dedicated frozen source-audit manifest inputs, hashing the final summary and ten scoped sources. Verified the permitted finalized candidate16 source-only audit hash, compared final summary hash with its passed-summary hash and own retained candidate16 hash, and compared each source hash with that report. No prior snapshot, general input manifest or unrelated record was opened.

method.current_work: Bounded final-byte/source correspondence check only, with zero differences.
method.retained_work: Carry forward finalized candidate16 full-current-snapshot review, unseen Basic Room shuffle/player-count filter/Basic Repairs illustration/discard/Pod checks, and its retained governing-English/core/scopedFAQ/readable-card-image and actual compatible localization checks. Retained checks below are reused, not represented as freshly performed whole-language or complete unseen-card-corpus work.
method.output: Only full-iteration-12/source-audit.json. All prior audits and all inputs preserved unchanged.

retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.topic: All11 Basic Room tiles shuffled unseen and placed face down
retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.details: English setup step2 specifies unseen shuffle/random face-down Room placement, and step3 applies the same method to all Room1 tiles. Components and Basic Rooms establish eleven and that all are used. Candidate16 expands that cross-reference without adding an extra unused Basic tile or permitting face-up placement. Special printed Rooms remain separate.

sources.location: Room quantities; setup2-3; all11 Basic Rooms; Special Rooms

retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.details: Defining P as the actual number of players and removing cards requiring more players expresses the original higher-than-player-count filter for both Personal and Corporate decks. Separate shuffling, one of each dealt hidden, and receiving Objectives before Character draft remain. Player Number, number of character choices or remaining players during play is not substituted for setup player count.

sources.location: Crew setup16-17

retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.details: The large English illustrated card has printed extra cost2 and Out of Combat restriction. Performing it discards Basic Repairs itself plus two other Action cards, totaling three. The example expressly limits sufficiency to printed Action-card payment and retains separate requirements. Contamination cannot pay those extra costs or replace the named played Action card. Local Malfunction removal OR local Engine Repair/Break alternatives remain, and no fourth Action card or independent Room cost is added.

sources.location: Contamination cannot pay; illustrated Basic Repairs and Action-card extra-cost rule

retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.topic: Marker-first normal discard routing and exceptions
retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.details: The main paragraph and quick reference distinguish matching marker supply from face-up card discard areas. Own Action/Contamination discard, Item-color discard and separate Event/Attack/Wound piles remain. Explicit effect exceptions survive, including Search/Storage bottom-deck return, removed Contamination/Exploration and standard-death Item removal. The reorder creates no claim that every removed token/card returns to a normal supply.

sources.location: Discard areas; marker supplies; Contamination; Items, Search and Storage

retained_candidate16_new_wording_checks.details: Waiting on entry passes the current turn and retains bag-Noise exposure. At the start of the first round in later Player Phases, waiting/pass, launch or free exit with full two-Action round remain distinct. The second boarder can launch both occupants immediately; no veto or retained control is added. An Intruder in the Section forces all Characters in every Pod of that Section into its Room, not merely one occupant or one Pod. A later Malfunction prevents new entry but does not cancel existing occupants' wait/launch/exit options; the usual choice timing is retained.

sources.location: Evacuation Section and Escape Pods

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Identifies an existing Computer but grants no independent Action or benefit. Its relevance depends on another rule referring to the Computer, including Action/Item/Event cards. A Room Malfunction makes the Computer unavailable as though the icon were absent. This adds no general remote action or Computer action. Retained Log Key/Intranet/Intercom requirements remain specific.

sources.location: Rooms with a computer
Malfunction and unavailable Computer

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: The step18 reminder retains the already dealt Help card and matching numbered Inventory holder from steps14-15. It does not add another holder or renumber the drafted Character. All original step18 Character board/miniature/ten-card deck/fully loaded starting Weapon/two inactive Quest Items/discard space remain, as do Objective-before-draft and Player1 token timing.

sources.location: Crew setup14-20

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.topic: Active-player iteration and skipping passed players
retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Clockwise first-player order repeats for ordinary rounds while at least one active player has not passed. Passed players do not take more normal rounds, so their later Fire wounds are not repeatedly charged. The Player Phase proceeds to Events when all pass; one-Action-plus-pass and inability/unwillingness rules remain. Interruption after passing stays explicit and subject to normal requirements. Independent immediate game-end conditions remain separately stated.

sources.location: Player rounds; end conditions; Fire timing

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Nest and Slime Room have no Item count. Other newly explored Room tiles are rotated to point the revealed Exploration number toward the printed Counter symbol. No Item count is added to printed Special Rooms or Search-prohibited Rooms; retained Search limits and counter0 exception remain.

sources.location: Counter setting; Search and Room exclusions

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Both replace this Movement Noise roll. Silence ordinarily does nothing, with Slime converting it to Danger. Danger moves all eligible neighboring Intruders not already in Combat; if none eligible, adds Noise only in empty connected Corridors, including linked Technical Corridors. No second ordinary roll is added afterward. Retained Careful Movement/Reconnaissance overrides and Door movement rules remain operative.

sources.location: Careful Movement; Exploration and Noise; Doors

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.topic: Coupled endgame shuffle, draw and classification
retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: An Infected preliminary Scan or a pre-existing Larva triggers a complete shuffle of Action and Contamination from all three zones, top-four draw and result test. A Larva bypasses only the preliminary Scan. Any drawn Contamination kills, Infected or not; only Action cards means survival of this check, followed by Objective verification. No-Larva/no-Infected branch remains no draw; no automatic non-Infected removal is invented.

sources.location: Victory Check, Contamination A/B and Objective check

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: The positive statement that only Plasma Torch may close a Destroyed Door is equivalent to the English general prohibition with its sole named exception. Other Door-closing effects cannot bypass it. The active illustrated Plasma Torch retains current-Room-connected Corridor targeting, cost1, Out of Combat and reuse; Door pool and Noise exceptions remain unchanged.

sources.location: Destroyed Doors and sole Plasma Torch exception
Illustrated active Plasma Torch

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.topic: Egg acquisition comparison and Noise scope
retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Nest-board Egg extraction is the local Take one Egg Room Action, cost2 and then Noise. A previously dropped Egg in the Character Room is one Heavy Object picked up by cost1 Basic Action with no Noise instruction of its own. Both become carried Heavy Objects and therefore use a Hand slot under ordinary capacity/drop rules. Normal Room/Basic Combat restrictions remain explicit. Loose Eggs do not replenish the Nest pool; pickup is not confused with a destruction attempt requiring Noise.

sources.location: Pick Up Heavy Object; Hands/Objects; Room restrictions; Nest extraction

retained_candidate15_new_wording_checks.details: Five-card refill, reshuffle on required own Action-deck draw when empty, first-player transfer after draw except turn1, face-up normal card discard routing and separate marker-pool returns match the main reference. Explicit Search/Storage bottom-deck and removal exceptions remain. Gained Contamination enters own Action discard; no Contamination-payment permission or replenishment of removed cards is added.

sources.location: Discard areas; refill/token; Contamination; marker pools and Search/Storage

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: General payment totals and separate requirements
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: An Action card is itself discarded in addition to its printed extra-card cost: n + 1 total Action cards. Basic/Room/Item Actions do not add a nonexistent played Action card to their printed payment. Separate Ammo, components and one-use Item disposal remain required. Craft explicitly costs one Action card plus two matching discarded Item cards; availability and icon matching remain. No Action-card effect is treated as free merely because its printed extra cost is zero.

sources.location: Action costs; Action-card extra costs; Craft Item icon and procedure; reference

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Number allocation, Inventory matching and character draft order
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Help cards 1 through player count randomly establish Player Numbers; Inventory matches that number. Objectives still precede drafting. Drafting in Player Number order still draws two publicly, selects one and shuffles the unchosen card back before the next player draws; remaining deck only removed after all choose. Player1 starts with First Player token and retains it for the first turn, with later leftward transfers at the usual phase step. No new simultaneous draft or premature discard is introduced.

sources.location: Setup14-19; First Player token step

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The new routing sentence restates normal discarded Action and gained Contamination placement, matching Item pile, each Event/Attack/Wound pile and marker supplies. Its ordinary-discard context and explicit effect exceptions remain. Search/Storage unchosen Item goes face down under the chosen deck; removed Contamination/Exploration and standard-death Items are not routed back as ordinary reusable supplies.

sources.location: Discard piles; marker returns; Contamination; Items and Search/Storage

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The new compact sequence retains Time/Self-Destruct, Intruder attacks, Intruder Fire injury checks, Event movement before Event effect, then bag development. It preserves all bag types, immediate Adult token return per FAQ, and completion of consequences before the next Player Phase. Immediate end conditions remain separately explicit; the sequence does not erase them.

sources.location: Event phase and end of turn; immediate end conditions; Fire/Injury effects

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Encounter token retention and unexplored Rooms
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Moving the keep-aside reminder into draw step2 preserves the non-Blank token outside the bag, while the separate Blank procedure returns Blank and handles last-token Adult addition. No token is returned early merely because the miniature was placed. The same-type hiding return, pool reuse and technical-corridor removal remain. An Intruder ending movement in an unexplored Room stays on board without revealing tile/token; this is distinguished from entering a Technical Corridor.

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Ordinary Shoot miss causes zero target Injuries and no shooter Wound; ordinary Melee miss causes zero target Injuries and one Serious Wound. This remains separate from normal pre-roll Melee Contamination. Specific Weapon/card modifiers and the Egg miss exception are explicitly excluded from this ordinary-case simplification, preserving Full Auto, Flamethrower and Egg distinctions.

sources.location: Shoot/Melee die outcomes and illustrated exceptions

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: After the stated scan-or-Larva trigger and full shuffle, any Contamination among the top four kills regardless of its Infected status. Four Action cards with no Contamination survives that check. Harmless Action draws do not activate normal Action-card effects or remove the need for final Objective checks. No-Larva/no-Infected branch still avoids the draw, and a Larva only bypasses the preliminary Scan.

sources.location: Victory check, Contamination stepsA/B and Objectives

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: One Ammo on a searched Weapon is not extended to every Heavy Item. Two Hand slots, open Heavy information, attachment cards treated as one and Duct Tape combining two Heavy Item cards into one slot while excluding Heavy Objects are preserved. retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The five printed Special Rooms are distinguished from Nest and Slime Room tile exclusions, all forbidding Search. Ordinary counter decrease/zero limit and Scout exception remain. Fire/Malfunction do not themselves prevent Search, subject to its card requirements. Storage Room Action is separate at counter zero. retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Pod launch decision of second boarder
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The new boarder may launch immediately with both occupants. The first occupant choosing to wait does not grant a veto or reserved launch control. Later-turn wait/launch/free-exit choices, Intruder ejection, Malfunction and final contamination/Objective checks remain.

sources.location: Escape Pods, second occupant launch

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Empty hand, declared Pass and end-of-round timing
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Completing two Actions with no hand is not automatic Pass. The finished round receives its end effects; passing is declared in the later passing round, with Fire at the end of that round and possible further Bleeding as FAQ18 explains. Usual round eligibility and choice rules remain stated in Turn Structure, as does Interruption after passing with normal locality/card requirements. The timing clarification supplies no new early automatic Pass or immunity to that passing-round Fire.

sources.location: Player rounds/pass; Fire after completed/passing round

retained_clarity_claims_checked.details: Normal Actions stop after passing; Interruption exception remains subject to usual requirements. Pass-time hand discard and own passing-round Fire timing remain. Empty-hand delayed pass and same-Room Interruption restriction still stated separately.

retained_clarity_claims_checked.topic: Room Action prerequisites and remote exceptions
retained_clarity_claims_checked.details: Cost2, presence, out of Combat and no Room Malfunction grouped near both descriptions. Explicit special-ability location exceptions retained; Scientist research still requires Object in Laboratory. Passive Cabins/Slime features remain marked passive/no Action, and Action/Item Engine Repair/Break retains its own Malfunction exception.

Silence/Danger Exploration results replace the movement Noise roll rather than adding another roll. Ordinary empty/occupied rule and other Exploration resolution retained. Careful Movement/Reconnaissance overrides remain explicit and supersede automatic Silence/Danger. Slime entry ordering and special Rooms unchanged.

retained_clarity_claims_checked.topic: Per-row selected Item cost and consumption

Successful Egg Melee Contamination and missed waiver/timing gap preserved. Noise follows each Character attack attempt including misses, remote Grenade/Molotov in acting Room; passive Fire is separated from those attempts.
Card discard piles distinguished from marker-pool returns. Search/Storage bottom-deck exceptions, removed Contamination/Exploration, token reuse and standard-death Item removal all retained.

retained_scope_statement_checks.topic: Unmarked card or Item Action eligibility
retained_scope_statement_checks.details: English p.12 permits unmarked effects in or out of Combat subject to requirements. FAQ Actions4 limits Basic Actions in Combat to fight/escape and forbids Room Actions. Candidate13 explicitly preserves these as separate limits, eliminating possible table-level generalization to unmarked Basic/Room Actions. Positive In Combat and Out of Combat rows still use presence/absence of an Intruder in the Character Room; Eggs remain excluded.

retained_scope_statement_checks.topic: Fire Weakness and Nest Egg pool
retained_scope_statement_checks.details: English p.25 retains the normal one-uncarried-Egg destruction during each Fire Damage step. FAQ Rooms7 expressly gives the two-Egg Vulnerability modifier for the Nest pool represented on the Intruder board. Candidate13 now states that exact narrower scope, without asserting a wider interaction for loose Eggs. FAQ Rooms9 distinction between loose Objects and Nest hit points is preserved. No new Noise roll is assigned to passive Event Fire.

source_limitations: The allowed manual/FAQ packet lacks the complete original Action, Item, Quest, Objective and Weakness card corpus. Full-core card-level completeness remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Selected tiny or overlapped illustrations cannot establish every hidden requirement. Candidate explicitly requires actual-card lookup; Grenade full normal procedure is not reconstructed from tiny artwork.
All eight Adults already in Combat leaves the English p.15 model-supply procedure unspecified.
Queen development adding an Egg after Nest destruction is not resolved by the supplied English rules/FAQ.
Normal Melee pre-roll Contamination draw versus Egg miss waiver lacks an explicit timing/refund procedure, even with PL/FR corroboration.
English first-death versus any-death Pod unlock wording remains inconsistent; the candidate preserves that limitation.
The medical repair states permission to treat another Character, not a full targeting-distance ruling.
